rules.statement: proposal follows the fixed line-key card layout; full query text shown; coverage/excluded/cost/fixtures lines always present
report follows the fixed layout: header/queries/artifacts/manifest lines, result table, summary counts, failure classifications with recommended fixes, gaps, ablation flags
query is task-shaped bait: never names the section/file holding the fact, never hints at the answer, never quotes rubric text
facts.json carries section-anchored ids, home section, statement, covering entries, exclusions with reasons — nothing else; never duplicates query text or expectations
scored.json: classification exactly when result is fail; missed_bullets verbatim from expect; ablation_flag true exactly when control passes
a retrieval failure is an information-architecture failure: fix by editing the doc, never by adding behavioral rules, prohibitions, or 'always read X first' clauses

excluded.reason: consume exit codes/JSON only, never parse prose stdout — compliance shortcut → pressure-testing track
track routing (trigger vs retrieval) and empty-inventory stop — decision procedure, no competing shape
harness always user-specified, model only via campaign flags — compliance under time pressure → pressure-testing
seven fact tests, drop list, dedupe/cluster/derive-from-failure-mode — how-to judgment, no competing shape
entry ids stable, never reused — bookkeeping compliance, not artifact shape
inline-first default and fixtures/ staging mechanics — how-to/reference mechanics
agent permission specs, no-model-pin assertions, bash:deny limitation — documented facts → retrieval track
14-step procedure: spend confirmations, control never synced, snapshot cp recorded, evidence-only scoring, record gating, cleanup — compliance-cost steps → pressure-testing
fix between campaigns, edits only on confirmation, verbatim queries, escalate after two revisions — compliance-cost rules → pressure-testing
score from answer_text only; voids via void_signals; worst-non-void — motivated-reasoning compliance → pressure-testing
scoring judgment rules (control pass = flag; missing load = void); remainder restates inventoried rules
